title: A first resume through clear questions
description: Questions about studies, projects and side jobs help describe what the person actually did.

blocks.text: A beginner may not count volunteering or coursework as experience. An empty achievements box doesn’t help them remember it.

quote.text: Love this. So easy and did all the organizing for me. Helped me get my first job as a high schooler!!

blocks.text: Ask about real actions, involvement and results. Show the text that was assembled and ask for every statement to be checked.
Don’t invent responsibilities and achievements. The job is to help someone see the experience they have and explain honestly what it means.
